note: No CLEAR / MANAGEABLE / BLOCKING judgement exists. The gate is decided by real human findings, never by structural automation.
whyThisGateExists: The Class 11 audit found the unit-to-lesson mapping is many-to-many: 35 of 90 lessons carry several canonical units, and 26 units are taught across several lessons. That is structurally legal and materially unchecked. Class 12 would inherit the same decomposition approach, so Wave 1 tests it first.

outcomes.CLEAR: No systemic granularity or source-mapping issue found. Class 12 may inherit the architecture.
outcomes.MANAGEABLE: Findings are local and repairable without changing the decomposition approach. Class 12 may proceed, with the local repairs tracked.
outcomes.BLOCKING: Human review shows a repeated structural problem — multi-unit lessons regularly failing a mapped objective, materially confusing duplication across lessons, repeated SHOULD_SPLIT, or a source-mapping architecture needing revision. Class 12 decomposition does not begin until the architecture is corrected.
